name: Asseco Business Solutions S.A.
summary: Asseco Business Solutions S.A. designs and develops enterprise software solutions in Poland and internationally. The company offers enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, including softlab ERP, macrologic ERP, and wapro ERP for business management of large, medium, and small enterprises, as well as business cloud solutions. It also provides mobile touch, a sales force automation solution; connector, a data integration and management platform, as well as faktor, a factoring solution; and direct portal, an online store platform.
